neighbours.label: talk of making something better or a new improved version (improved, better ways, will fix, more precise), not neutral mention of the same thing
fire: Later chemists refined the method and made it far more accurate.
The second release will correct the errors in the first version.
Surely there are better methods to teach children how to read.
Engineers upgraded the pump, and the new model runs much quieter.
The patch fixes several crashes and improves loading times.
This revised edition is clearer and more complete than the original.
Each generation of the engine has been lighter and more efficient.
Nurses have found better ways to dress these wounds.
quiet: Later chemists described the method in a short journal article.
The second release came out on a Friday in late September.
Surely there are many children in the town learning to read.
Engineers inspected the pump, and the model number was on its side.
The patch is a small file stored in the downloads folder.
This edition is bound in green cloth and sits next to the original.
Each generation of the family has lived in the same house.

notes: Card: ' more' x3, ' to' x3, plus made, ways, will, edition, includes, clearer, design. The shared pattern is improvement over a previous state. Probes: 'will fix the bugs' 0.548, 'better ways' 0.456, 'improved the design' 0.446, 'made more precise' 0.374, 'adds more content' 0.262; neutral sentences at 0.04 or less. 'search for new treatments' 0.115 and 'make thoughts clearer' 0.127 were weak.
